data.description: Elderly neighbor, diabetic, does not know West Suburban closed. Has not refilled insulin in 4 days.
Mother requesting information on pediatric asthma care. West Suburban ER was go-to for son's attacks.
92-year-old wheelchair user. Was getting regular dialysis transport to West Suburban. Needs new transport arrangement.
Group of residents from Central Ave asking where nearest ER is. Confused by rumors Loretto also closing.
Pregnant woman, 7 months. Lost OB when St. Elizabeth closed last year. Asking where to deliver.
Church pastor requesting bulk information packets for congregation. 'People are panicking.'
Family worried about father with heart condition. South Shore Hospital rumored to close next.
Pharmacy on Madison St reports spike in patients asking for emergency prescription refills with no doctor on file.
Neighbor reports elderly man with oxygen tank has not been seen leaving apartment in 5 days. Used to go to West Suburban weekly.
Home health aide for 3 patients in Austin. All had appointments at West Suburban next week. Cannot reach anyone to reschedule.
Spanish-speaking mother with sick infant. Went to Norwegian American but could not communicate symptoms. Requesting interpreter services.
Alderman's office requesting data on how many constituents were West Suburban patients. No central registry exists.
Diabetic woman missed her last 2 appointments because she thought Roseland Hospital was closing. It is still open.
Mental health counselor reports 6 patients lost to follow-up since West Suburban behavioral health unit closed. Cannot locate them.
Community organization requesting translated materials about clinic alternatives. Spanish and Polish needed.
